prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE square detailed painterly naturalistic folklore encyclopedia portrait of Bysen from Gotland, Sweden. One SMALL old grey man with weathered face, grey beard, grey woodland clothing, a visible RED KNITTED CAP and simple small WOODCUTTING AXE held calmly down beside him. Full diminutive human figure against a large mossy stump and northern forest trees; normal two arms and two legs, human ears. Damp forest twilight and crooked winding path; watchful stern sidelong expression, uncanny mischievous woodland-guardian atmosphere, neither a cute toy nor demonic horror. The axe is for woodcutting and not an ornate battle weapon. Keep cap red and visibly knitted, head grey and aged, subject small. No horns, glowing eyes, fairy wings, wizard staff, giant pointed gnome hat, victims or extra beings. Entire silhouette comfortably framed. No text, runes, lettering, borders or watermark. Contemporary artistic interpretation of the documented old-man variant.
visual_requirements: Gotland forest and mischievous guardian aura
depicted_variant: Bysen in his small grey old-man form wearing the documented red knit cap and carrying a woodcutting axe in the Gotland forest.
aura: Uncanny mischievous woodland guardian with a watchful stern presence.

visual_review.notes: Short elderly human man with beard and hat; no nonhuman anatomical features.
